_comment: Ceiling for hex color literals in src/App.jsx, enforced by scripts/audit-hex-leaks.js. Ratcheted down to 55 after migrating the theme-independent whites to the new --color-white token and removing three non-color hex matches (two token hexes in the ACCENT palette comment, now referencing the token names, and a '#108' PR reference in a comment, now 'PR 108'). The 55 remaining literals are all justified: (1) 50 HERO_SLIDES colors in AppIntroOverlay — 10 destination slides each with a 4-stop gradient plus a 1-color accent; intentional per-destination palettes that cannot be expressed as shared design tokens; (2) 3 html2canvas/jsPDF rasterizer whites (#ffffff) — the canvas rasterizer does not resolve CSS custom properties, so these must be real hex; (3) 1 copied-to-clipboard success green (#2d6a4f) — a deliberate one-off deeper green for the button's transient 'copied' flash; (4) 1 navy CTA text color (#1c2840) on the white Plan Trip button over the fixed dark hero — must stay navy in both themes, so a theme-flipping token (--color-text-primary/--color-gold both invert in dark) cannot be used. Never raise it without justification.
